sources.entry: Luphra - Prompt-to-matter: AI that turns prompts and sketches into editable 3D and physical products. #freemium

summary.name: Luphra
summary.one_liner: Luphra is an AI-assisted CAD tool that turns a text description, photo, or sketch into a dimensioned 3D model you can refine in chat, download as editable STEP and STL files, or order as a physical print if eligible.
keywords: design a custom bracket with ai
use_cases: Designing custom enclosures or project box covers
Making brackets with specified hole spacing
Creating tube adapters that slide over a known tube size
Generating an editable STEP file to refine in Fusion or FreeCAD
Ordering a PLA or PETG print of an eligible design
summary.what_it_does: Users describe a part, attach a reference photo or sketch, and add any known measurements. Luphra generates a first 3D model, usually within a few minutes, which can be refined through chat requests. Each finished model downloads as an STL for printing and a STEP solid for editing in CAD tools such as Fusion, SolidWorks, Onshape, or FreeCAD; STEP does not include sketch constraints or feature history. Automated manufacturing checks determine whether a print is eligible and show a quote, but the page states these checks do not certify fit, strength, or safety.
notable: Outputs both editable STEP solid and STL mesh for every model
Refine design through chat requests before downloading or ordering
Automated DFM checks gate eligibility for physical prints
Standard print orders support PLA or PETG parts under 220 mm per side, shipping within the US
caveats: Print orders are limited to PLA or PETG, under 220 mm on every side, and shipped within the US; manufacturing is billed separately from the design
Fit, strength and safety are not guaranteed; the user must measure and test prototypes
